en.titre:
10/10 hobbies that make you
smarter if you have adhd

colonne: you hear right away if a note is wrong, and every song you learn is a clear _level up_
en.chute: one song, ten minutes a day

en.accroche: one painting at a time, _one story_ at a time
colonne: each painting teaches you a bit of history, a technique and a hidden detail
_pro tip_: artura gives me one painting a day and the story behind it, in a few minutes
en.chute: start with one painting a day

en.accroche: the sky is a _map_ you can _learn_
colonne: finding one new star or planet each night gives a curious brain a small _mission_
en.chute: go somewhere dark and look for one constellation

en.accroche: your brain reads _every rock_ and _every step_
colonne: rough ground keeps your attention sharp, and a race goal gives the training a _direction_
_pro tip_: atala builds my runs around my goal and adjusts them every week
en.chute: walk the climbs, run the flats

colonne: every number you place is a small win, and you always know exactly _what's left_
en.chute: start with the easy ones, the hard ones come fast
